# logger

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/logger"
```

Package logger is a slog.Handler that prints for people: time, level and message on one line, every attribute under it as a branch of a tree. Pane shows the same lines in a panel that follows the end, filtered with /.

## Constants

<a name="DefaultLimit"></a>DefaultLimit is the lines a Pane keeps until WithLimit says otherwise.

```go
const DefaultLimit = 5000
```

<a name="DefaultTimeFormat"></a>DefaultTimeFormat is the time each line starts with; WithTimeFormat\(""\) drops it.

```go
const DefaultTimeFormat = "2006-01-02 15:04:05"
```

<a name="LevelTrace"></a>LevelTrace is below slog.LevelDebug, for the detail only a bug hunt wants.

```go
const LevelTrace = slog.LevelDebug - 4
```

## func [ReplaceAttr](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/logger/logger.go#L334>)

```go
func ReplaceAttr(groups []string, a slog.Attr) slog.Attr
```

<a name="Handler"></a>
## type [Handler](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/logger/logger.go#L57-L69>)

Handler is the slog.Handler; slog.New\(logger.New\(os.Stderr, th\)\) is a logger. Every copy writes through the same lock, so lines never interleave.

```go
type Handler struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

### func [New](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/logger/logger.go#L87>)

```go
func New(w io.Writer, th theme.Resolved) Handler
```

New prints to w in th's colours from slog.LevelInfo up. On a terminal it draws in colour and wraps at the terminal's width; anywhere else it writes plain text, one line per value.

<a name="Pane"></a>
## type [Pane](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/logger/pane.go#L32-L47>)

Pane is a log panel that follows the end as lines arrive and holds still while the reader scrolls up. / filters it as list and table do, but enter keeps the filter: a log has nothing to choose. Its copies share one feed.

```go

    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="PaneStyles"></a>
## type [PaneStyles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/logger/pane.go#L76-L82>)

PaneStyles are how a Pane paints: the lines its Handler writes, and its own parts around them.

```go
type PaneStyles struct {
    Lines  Styles         // what the Handler writes
    More   lipgloss.Style // the count of lines that arrived while it held still
    Prompt lipgloss.Style // the / prompt while it takes the keys
    Filter lipgloss.Style // the filter kept after enter
    Match  lipgloss.Style // every match of the filter
}
```

<a name="DefaultPaneStyles"></a>
### func [DefaultPaneStyles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/logger/pane.go#L86>)

```go
func DefaultPaneStyles(th theme.Resolved) PaneStyles
```

DefaultPaneStyles paint the lines as the Handler does, the count and the kept filter dim, the prompt as the cursor and the matches as matches.

<a name="Styles"></a>
## type [Styles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/logger/logger.go#L32-L36>)

Styles is how each part of a line is drawn.

```go
type Styles struct {
    Time, Caller                    lipgloss.Style
    Trace, Debug, Info, Warn, Error lipgloss.Style
    Key, Equals, Branch             lipgloss.Style
}
```

<a name="DefaultStyles"></a>
### func [DefaultStyles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/logger/logger.go#L40>)

```go
func DefaultStyles(th theme.Resolved) Styles
```

DefaultStyles is the levels in the theme's info, warning and danger colours, the keys in its accent, and the time and the tree in its quieter ones.
